scenes.title: Don't buy these Land Cruiser Prado 150 years

scenes.body: Unsealed 4X4 flags launch-year trucks for airbag recalls and electrical gremlins.
Unsealed 4X4 flags 2017 trucks for head-unit, ESC-light and shift glitches and says not to buy one without paperwork showing they've been fixed.
Unsealed 4X4 calls 2013–15 a sweet spot for many buyers: past the early faults and before the DPF.
